mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ID, OWNER_ID, TITLE, STATUS, AMOUNT, MAX_MEMBERS FROM GYE_GROUP WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT DISSOLUTION_REQUEST_ID, GROUP_ID, REQUESTED_BY, REASON, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM ( SELECT DISSOLUTION_REQUEST_ID, GROUP_ID, REQUESTED_BY, REASON, STATUS, CREATED_AT FROM DISSOLUTION_REQUEST WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, DISSOLUTION_REQUEST_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT dr.DISSOLUTION_REQUEST_ID AS dissolutionRequestId, dr.GROUP_ID AS groupId, g.TITLE AS groupTitle, g.STATUS AS groupStatus, dr.REQUESTED_BY AS requestedBy, m.NAME AS leaderName, dr.REASON AS reason, dr.STATUS AS status, dr.DECIDED_BY AS decidedBy, dr.DECIDED_AT AS decidedAt, dr.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GYE_MEMBER gm WHERE gm.GROUP_ID = dr.GROUP_ID AND gm.STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS memberCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT_PROOF pp WHERE pp.GROUP_ID = dr.GROUP_ID AND pp.STATUS != 'CONFIRMED') AS unconfirmedProofCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST wr WHERE wr.GROUP_ID = dr.GROUP_ID AND wr.STATUS IN ('SETTLEMENT_PENDING', 'CONSENT_PENDING')) AS activeWithdrawalCount, (SELECT NVL(SUM(pp2.AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT_PROOF pp2 WHERE pp2.GROUP_ID = dr.GROUP_ID AND pp2.STATUS = 'CONFIRMED') AS totalConfirmedAmount FROM DISSOLUTION_REQUEST dr JOIN GYE_GROUP g ON dr.GROUP_ID = g.GROUP_ID JOIN MEMBER m ON dr.REQUESTED_BY = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE dr.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} ORDER BY dr.CREATED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DISSOLUTION_REQUEST ( DISSOLUTION_REQUEST_ID, GROUP_ID, REQUESTED_BY, REASON, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_DISSOLUTION_REQUEST.NEXTVAL, #{groupId}, #{requestedBy}, #{reason}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ADMIN WHERE ADMIN_ID = #{adminId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT ADMIN_ID FROM ADMIN WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WITHDRAWAL_REQUEST WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS IN ('SETTLEMENT_PENDING', 'CONSENT_PENDING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYOUT_REQUEST WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'CONSENT_PENDING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PAYMENT_PROOF WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS != 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT NVL(SUM(AMOUNT), 0) FROM PAYMENT_PROOF WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'CONFIRMED'
SELECT MEMBER_ID FROM GYE_MEMBER WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.update: UPDATE DISSOLUTION_REQUEST SET STATUS = #{status}, DECIDED_BY = #{adminId}, DECIDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND DISSOLUTION_REQUEST_ID = #{dissolutionRequestId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
